scoring.recall_at_5: 1 if any expected_doc appears anywhere in the top-k results, else 0
scoring.recall_at_1: 1 if the single top-ranked result is an expected_doc, else 0
scoring.record_accuracy: 1 if all expected_fields match the returned structured record, else 0
scoring.note: n = 11 for document retrieval and n = 11 for operational record lookups.

provenance: All 22 corpus files and SQLite database tables were verified. Scoreable = 7 Document questions (1-7), document half of 4 Composite (14-17), 6 Record questions (8-13), record half of 4 Composite (14-17), and 1 Non-existent record query (28).

questions.question: how long till they get their money back on a return?
questions.rationale: Vocab test: 'money back' must match 'refund' chunks. amazon/refund_timelines.md: '3-5 business days for the refund amount to appear in your account'. target/returns.md § Refund methods and timing: 'Third-party credit cards: up to 5 days'. bestbuy/returns.md: 'processed within 7-10 business days'.

questions.question: customer's parcel never showed up — what's our process?
questions.rationale: amazon/order_tracking.md § If you can't find your package and bestbuy/order_tracking.md § Still can't find it.

questions.question: can they send back opened electronics?
questions.rationale: bestbuy/returns.md (14 days for cellular), target/returns.md (30 days for electronics), amazon/returns.md (opened items subject to partial refund).

questions.question: what's covered under warranty and for how long?
questions.rationale: ikea/warranty_terms.md (25-year kitchen, 10-year sofas), amazon/warranty.md (1-year Amazon Basics), ikea/warranty.md (appliance coverage 365 days).

questions.question: they want to return after 40 days, are we allowed?
questions.rationale: Refusal case: amazon/returns.md (30 days) and bestbuy/returns.md (15 days) both justify refusal (40 > 30 and 40 > 15).

questions.question: returns window AND who pays return shipping?
questions.rationale: Two-part question: return windows + prepaid label/shipping policies.

questions.question: does every store charge a 'restocking fee' on returns?
questions.rationale: Deliberate conflict: Best Buy charges $45 on activatable devices, while IKEA and Target do not charge restocking fees.

questions.question: I was charged twice — is that allowed and did it actually happen? (document half only)
questions.rationale: amazon/charged_twice.md: Authorization holds look like duplicate charges and release within 5-7 business days.

questions.question: can they return order [REF] — what's the window and is it eligible? (document half only)
parcel split into two — is partial delivery covered, and what shipped? (document half only)
refund on [REF] — how long should it take and did it go through? (document half only)
questions.rationale: Refund processing timing policies across brands.
